title: Open the CAD project: a complete part-by-part model of the car, shown in the app's Manual
body:
**A new project, `02-PROJECTS/05-cad`, owns building one complete model of the car that can be assembled part by part, with every dimension's origin stated, and handing it to the app's Manual for service visuals and interactive views of the car and its systems.** Phase PROPOSED.

His words (chat, 2026-10-11): "will you add a new porject named 05-CAD, with the end goal of haveing a full complete part by part assemblable model of the rx7. this perfect mathmatically dialed realistic model should then be facored into the app manual for real visuals of service or just interactive views of the car and its systems."

Readings taken:
- "05-CAD": the directory is `05-cad`, lower case like its four siblings; the title in the app is CAD.
- "perfect mathmatically dialed realistic": every governing dimension of every part carries where it came from - measured on this car, a factory figure, or a found model - and one that has not been measured carries `confirm` (R11). The model is as true as its measurements and never becomes a source of facts about the car: where a measured number and the model disagree, the model is wrong.
- "part by part assemblable": one modelled part per 00-CAR `parts` row, each its own solid, put together by its mates and fasteners, so any part can be shown alone, in place, or coming off.
- "facored into the app manual": the model and its export are this project's; showing it is the app's own work and stays in 02-APP (D-428), as row MG1 gated on this project's hand-over row C01.

Boundary, read from the record before opening:
- 01-REFERENCE keeps what was found, not made: table `cad` (900 free models, scans and drawings, the files out of git) and the one combined model of D-418 (`blend`, seven pieces: an FB shell scaled from a 3D Warehouse model to the factory length, a 12A assembled from a 13B-REW working model, wheels from the specs, the scanned tail lamps, and the SA and LS3 overlays). This project uses those as starting shapes and as checks, and does not catalogue them again. What it models itself is its own, in its own tables (work row A03).
- 00-CAR `parts` (975 rows), `systems` (14) and `zones` (9) are the list the model follows. `parts.model_at_mm` and `zones.model_box_mm` (D-421) stay 00-CAR's and are filled from this model once it exists.
- 02-APP already shows renders and a turnable view of the combined model (D-415, D-420, D-421). Those stand until MG1 replaces them.
- The frame is D-418's: millimetres, x to the car's right, y forward, z up, ground z = 0, front axle y = 0.
- Files: the scripts that build the model go in git; the model files and anything made from a found model stay out of git as D-418's do, while 01-REFERENCE block REF.01 (what the public repository may carry) and 02-APP row P55 (a second home for the model library) are open. Neither is asked again here.
- Machines: the Mac holds FreeCAD and 45 MB of the model library; Blender and the other 3.4 GB are on the Fedora PC (`rx7.py doc machine`).

Not done: no 00-CAR `planned` row, because the model changes nothing on the car.

Consequences in the data: the area with the standard tables; opening blocks 05.01 (does he work in the model himself), 05.02 (how far inside a part the model goes), 05.03 (how real measurements get in); work A01-A05, B01-B02, C01; 02-APP work MG1.

title: He works the car's model through the app, not in a CAD program: the agent builds it from scripts, the app shows it, takes it apart and puts it together
body:
**The car's 3D model is built by the agent from scripts (FreeCAD, headless, on the Mac) and Camden works it through the app: he looks, isolates, takes apart and reassembles there. He does not edit the model in a CAD program. Any part can still be exported as STEP or STL for a shop or a printer.**

His words (chat, 2026-10-13): "thats looking way great so far, now how much and you find about the car body itself can ou peice together an idea of the wht unibody looks like and mock up the cad and we can touch it up with measurments as we go, this should live in the manual model page and should be he begining of acutally being able to dissabeble and reassembe the full car in cad via tha app. where every tiny detail ir a real part in cad and could be examined alone, aldd perfectally configured and attachable together to make the car."

The option taken, block 05.01 (a): "(a) Only look at it in the app. The agent builds it from scripts with free tools (FreeCAD, already on the Mac). Costs nothing and closes off nothing: any part can still be exported as a standard STEP or STL file for a machine shop or a 3D printer."

Why this reading: "disassemble and reassemble the full car in CAD via the app" names the app as the place he handles the model; nothing in his words asks for FreeCAD or another program in his hands. If he later wants to draw parts himself, that is a new block, and the scripts-only build loses nothing by it. Closes block 05.01; A04 (the tool-chain proof) is free to start.

title: Every part as it comes off the car is its own solid with its fasteners; a unit's insides are added when that unit is opened
body:
**The model goes as deep as the car comes apart: every part that comes off in one piece is its own solid, examined alone, located by its mates and fasteners; a unit's insides (the engine, the gearbox, the alternator) are modelled when that unit is opened on the bench, from what is seen then, without redoing anything around it.**

His words (chat, 2026-10-13): "thats looking way great so far, now how much and you find about the car body itself can ou peice together an idea of the wht unibody looks like and mock up the cad and we can touch it up with measurments as we go, this should live in the manual model page and should be he begining of acutally being able to dissabeble and reassembe the full car in cad via tha app. where every tiny detail ir a real part in cad and could be examined alone, aldd perfectally configured and attachable together to make the car."

The option taken, block 05.02 (a): "(a) Every part as it comes off the car, outside shape only, with its fasteners. Service views show removal and fitting. The insides of any one unit can be added later without redoing the rest."

Why this reading: "every tiny detail is a real part in CAD and could be examined alone, all perfectly configured and attachable together" is every part and fastener as it comes off, each one a solid that mates to its neighbour - which (a) gives, fasteners included. It does not name any unit's insides, and until a unit is apart its insides could come only from factory drawings, not from this car (R11). So the depth is (a) now, with the structure built so that any unit's insides are added later as children of that unit; if he means the insides of a unit from the start, he names it and it is added. Closes block 05.02; A05 (the parts plan) is free to start.

title: The unibody first: pieced together from the factory body dimensions, the found models and the blueprints, every structural panel its own part, shown in the Manual's model page - the start of taking the whole car apart and together in the app
body:
**The first pass of the car's model is the unibody: the floor pan, the front and rear frame rails, the sills, the firewall and cowl, the A- and B-pillars, the roof, the rear quarters and arches, the strut towers, the radiator support, the rear panel and the hatch aperture - each its own part, pieced together from the factory body-checking dimensions (the datums DT09-DT15 and the 1985 FSM body section), the overall dimensions (DT04-DT08), the blueprints and the found shell models where they are on this Mac, every dimension carrying how it is known, every unmeasured one confirm. It is shown in the Manual's model page, where the car is taken apart and put together part by part, and it is touched up with measurements as the strip proceeds.**

His words (chat, 2026-10-13): "thats looking way great so far, now how much and you find about the car body itself can ou peice together an idea of the wht unibody looks like and mock up the cad and we can touch it up with measurments as we go, this should live in the manual model page and should be he begining of acutally being able to dissabeble and reassembe the full car in cad via tha app. where every tiny detail ir a real part in cad and could be examined alone, aldd perfectally configured and attachable together to make the car."

Readings taken (CLAUDE.md §3): "how much can you find about the car body" is the research pass over what the record already holds (the datums, the FSM body section, the brochure dimensions, the cad table's body rows) and what the web adds (D-515: search first); "piece together an idea of what the unibody looks like and mock up the CAD" is a rough, parametric, part-per-panel model - state rough in model_parts, nothing drawn as a single skin; "we can touch it up with measurements as we go" is the model_dims rows moving from factory / found / guess to measured as the car comes apart (how he measures is still block 05.03 - this does not decide it); "live in the manual model page" is 02-APP MG1, which starts now against the same scene contract the electrical Design page uses (D-505), on a stub until the car's scene lands; "disassemble and reassemble … via the app" is the taken-apart position per part from its mate, and the systems' filter, in that page.

How it is built: the model's own scripts under 02-PROJECTS/05-cad/model (A04's tool chain: FreeCAD headless, one script per assembly, parts by their 00-CAR id, mates from model_mates, STEP and glb out), the car's scene under the app's public design folder keyed 00-CAR, the same contract as electrical's with kind body for the unibody's parts, system and zone on every part, and the mate carried so the viewer can take it apart. The found shell models live on the Fedora PC's model library (D-477; the Mac holds 45 MB of it, the body folder not among them): B03 is his copy, and until it lands the unibody comes from the factory figures and the blueprints, re-fetched where they are free. Nothing in it is a measurement (R11).

In the data: A04 and A05 READY (D-516, D-517 closed their blocks); B01's note names the unibody as the first pass's core; B03 (his: copy the body models from the Fedora PC); 02-APP MG1 starts beside C01 on a stub. Block 05.03 stays open.

title: Parts are measured by hand as they come off the car; no scanner, no purchase
body:
**The car's parts are measured by hand, as each comes off during the strip and the builds: calipers, a tape, and photos against a ruler. Nothing is bought; a 3D scanner and photo-to-3D software are not part of the method.**

Block 05.03 asked: "How do you want to capture the shapes and sizes of the car's parts so the model is true: by hand as parts come off, with a 3D scanner, or with phone photos?"

His answer (desktop, 2026-10-13), the option in full:
"(a) By hand: calipers, a tape and photos against a ruler, as each part comes off during the strip and the builds. Nothing to buy. True to about a millimetre on simple parts, weak on curved ones (body panels, the dash, trim). The most of your time."

He typed no words with the letter. The recommendation was (a) with (c) for the curved parts; he picked (a) alone, so (c) is not ruled in. Photo-to-3D stays open as a later, small addition if a curved part cannot be got by hand.

Consequences in the data:
- B02 (his measuring row) is gated on this block and A05, both now met: it is READY for the plan playbook to split into one row per system from the A05 parts plan.
- Every size not measured stays `confirm` until it is (R11); nothing is bought, so no sourcing row.
- B01 is unaffected: it goes ahead from factory figures and found models.

title: The manual's car model takes its outside from the home page's car: a skin assembly, and the unibody re-drawn inside it
body:
**The manual's car model takes its outside from the home page's car (B01's second pass).** Camden, 2026-10-13: "the manual model looks very rough please merge it with the model you have om the home page (dont ruin the home page) but use that cad model to improve the one in the manual model page so its like the real car with the parts in more real locations."

What changed:

- **A third assembly, `skin`** (model/skin/, pure python - the found model is a mesh, so no FreeCAD). It cuts the home page's FB model (01-INTAKE/model/rx7-fb.glb, read only, not moved or changed: the home page still loads the same file) into parts by the model's own materials and names, puts each in the car's frame (D-418) and writes one glb per part beside the corner and unibody parts. The model is already at factory size: its wheelbase and track land on DT02/DT03, so it is turned into the frame and not scaled. Parts: PT704-skin (the painted body, one piece: hood, fenders, doors, hatch, bumpers are not yet parts of their own), PT729 (all the glass, under the windshield's row), PT704-trim (bumpers' rubbers, garnishes, mirrors, seals and a rough cabin), PT601-L/R (the tail lamps; PT601's single planned row is split into the pair and PT604 now sits on PT601-R, the side the scan was taken from), and the FR, RL and RR wheels and tyres (PT525/PT530). The FL corner stays the corner assembly's, built from factory figures, so one corner shows what the model is when it is drawn from the record.
- **The unibody re-drawn inside that skin.** skin/stations.py slices the found model every 50 mm; unibody/params.py takes its overhangs, windshield base and corners, roof front, peak and rear, roof half-width, cowl, and the pillar, rail and quarter lines from those slices (how=found, each note keeping the figure it replaced), and geometry.py's pillars, cowl, rails and quarter follow them. The shell's half-width stays DT05's 834.4 (factory). skin/fit_check.py lists the panels that still stand outside the skin: the A-pillars by about 30 mm and a few smaller ones, left for the closures pass.
- **The record follows the model**: model_parts gains the ten skin parts and PT729 goes planned -> rough; model_dims and model_mates are re-synced from the export (57 dims and 11 mates added, the moved figures set). Everything stays confirm (R11): two models agreeing is not a measurement.

Small (§3): it moves no money, no cut and no wire, and undoing it is editing rows and deleting a folder. B01 stays open: the closures (hood, doors, hatch, fenders) as parts of their own, and the powertrain, are next.
